snippet.title: Wavertree Mountain | Species, Faction and Combat Abilities (First Look)
snippet.description:
Every species in Wavertree Mountain has an ability of its own, every rank of reputation with your faction unlocks another, and every weapon fights differently. Here's a first look at them, straight from the engine.

Species abilities:
- Burrow Dash (Chipmunk): dive into a tunnel and pop up somewhere else
- Scurry (Mouse): two lightning-quick darts
- Runner's Burst (Squirrel): a burst of speed
- Tail Drop (Lizard): leave the tail behind to keep them busy. It grows back
- Slip the Cage (Rat): break free, and nothing holds you for a while
- Drum Warning (Gerbil): thump out a warning everyone nearby can hear
- Hide: every species can do this one

Faction abilities, unlocked with reputation:
- Warren Compact: Warren Paths (Friendly), Hold the Line (Trusted), Warren Hearth (Revered)
- Ashborne League: Old Routes (Friendly), Raid Call (Trusted), Scatter (Revered)

Weapon abilities:
- Sword and spear: Spin Attack, Strong Slash, Piercing Stab
- Staff: Skull Crack, Stabbing Blow
- Bow: Power Shot, Double Shot, Hobble Shot
- Boomerang: Skull Crack

Specialisation abilities:
- Warrior: Battle Cry pulls every enemy nearby onto you, War Cry toughens up your group, Endure refuses a killing blow, and the capstone turns every strike to embers
- Engineer: a Shield Generator that soaks up hits, and System Overload to supercharge your gadgets
- Angler: Tide Caller brings the fish in

Wavertree Mountain is an indie MMORPG in development, set on an island the humans left behind. These effects are new and the footage is work in progress.

One purchase. No subscription. No pay-to-win.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4725370/Wavertree_Mountain/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=abilities
